description:
Custard Apple Gelato - Chirimoya, Anone, Sitafal, Srikaya Fruity, and Tropical Homemade Gelato Recipe! 🍨 

This custard apple gelato is ultra-creamy, tropical, and full of the delicate sweetness of custard apple (also known as cherimoya or sitaphal). With the perfect balance of dairy and fruit, it’s a beautifully smooth frozen treat you can make at home. Whether you’re a gelato enthusiast or just love exotic fruits, this recipe is a must-try!

👇 FULL RECIPE BELOW 👇

📌 Ingredients:
 • 375g Custard Apple flesh (2.5 cups) (strained and deseeded)
 • 321g Whole Milk (1.25 cups)
 • 254g Cream (33% +fat)  (1 cup)
 • 128g Sugar (0.5 cup+ 2tbsp)
 • 45g Glucose Syrup (3tbsp)
 • 55g Skim Milk Powder (3.5 tbsp)
 • 2g Guar Gum (0.5tsp)

🕒 TIMESTAMPS:
0:00 – Intro
1:36 – Ingredients
2:19 – Prep
3:34 – Spin
3:34 – Blending and straining
4:10 – Scoopy scoop!
5:20 – More fruit info
6:32 – Outro

🔧 PRO TIPS:
 • Always strain the custard apple well to remove seeds and fibrous bits.
 • Useing glucose syrup will prevent extreme ice crystals formation
